text:
taylor: Just opened a rapid docs hotfix PR to add the Statuspage link and a short workaround for the auth outage. Need one reviewer + docs-preview green to merge and backport. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/479

ryan: grabbing this now. Which statuspage URL?

(taylor): https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-auth-outage-6 — plan is to add a callout on /docs/known-issues.md and a brief note in the incident response guide.

cate: one quick content Q: the workaround references retrying on 401s, can we show the async python snippet as the recommended approach and keep the curl snippet as legacy?

taylor: yep updated the PR to include async-first, curl fallback. also added a single-line explanation why async is preferred (non-blocking backoff).

ryan: preview build failed — MDX error from using a markdown link inside the callout macro. switch to raw URL or plain text in the admonition. I'll push a tiny fix. :wrench:

cate: also noticed a tiny wording nit in the callout: change "we're working on" to "we rotated auth cache; some customers saw brief 401s" for accuracy.

ryan: applied both fixes and re-ran preview.

preview-bot: docs-preview: build succeeded (preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-479)

ops: quick note — please include the preview URL and the target stable backport branch in the PR description so support can reference it (stable-2026-03).

kevin: product eyes: wording looks good after the nit. one suggestion: add a 1-line heading in the callout "Affected endpoints: auth token validation" so SEs know which area to reference quickly.

taylor: added the heading and pushed.

cate: approving once preview link is present in PR description and support is pinged.

taylor: updated PR description with preview URL and backport plan, pinged #support and #customer-success. merging and backporting now.

preview-bot: docs-preview: final check passed for backport build (stable preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/branch/stable-2026-03/pr-479)

taylor: merged to main and backported to stable-2026-03. added an entry to /internal/changelog.md: "docs hotfix: auth outage status link + workaround (PR #479)" and pinged support. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
